product.olivetti-m28-sp.summary: The M28 version Olivetti aimed at multi-user XENIX work.
product.olivetti-m28-sp.history: Deutsche Olivetti documented the M28 SP in February 1987 as its higher-end 80286 model. It aimed the SP at commercial multi-user work and local network service.
product.olivetti-m28-sp.architecture: The 70 MB disk appears in two formats. The Dutch brochure lists a full-size drive and the German brochure describes a 28 ms Slim-Line drive.
product.olivetti-m28-sp.verified: The configuration was checked against the cited sources. BluMach validation is pending.
product.olivetti-m28-sp.limitations: Firmware verification, boot tests and a photograph with clear publication rights are pending.
